description.es: Hotel de cabañas con restaurante a unos minutos del centro: cabañas amplias y frescas con baño, refrigerador pequeño, internet y clóset; estacionamiento gratis, alberca, room service y wifi. Apto para familias, niños y mascotas. Check-in de 3:00 a 7:00 PM. Desde $1,580 MXN por noche por cabaña.
description.en: Cabin hotel with a restaurant minutes from downtown: large, airy cabins with bathroom, small fridge, internet and closet; free parking, pool, room service and WiFi. Suitable for families, children and pets. Check-in 3:00–7:00 PM. From MX$1,580 per night per cabin.

address.es: A las afueras de Felipe Carrillo Puerto, Quintana Roo
address.en: Just outside Felipe Carrillo Puerto, Quintana Roo

verificationNote.es: Verificado en campo por el equipo (nov 2026): cabañas limpias, grandes y frescas, con buenos baños, refrigerador pequeño, internet y clóset. Ideal para niños y familias; hay personal disponible hasta las 9 PM; restaurante en el sitio. Acepta efectivo, Visa y Mastercard.
verificationNote.en: Field-verified by the team (Nov 2026): clean, large, airy cabins with nice bathrooms, small fridge, internet and closet. Great for kids and families; staff on call until 9 PM; restaurant on site. Accepts cash, Visa and Mastercard.

contactNote: Official website (hotelaldeacruzoob.com) was NOT working at verification — booking via phone or socials recommended. Amenities per listing: free parking, airport shuttle, non-smoking rooms, pool, room service, WiFi, family rooms, pet friendly.
